column3: Close to the Hebrew; “threw a great wind” is rendered “sent out a great wind,” and “the ship thought to be broken” “the ship was about to be broken up.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the vessels” is rendered “the cargo,” and “to lighten from on them” “to lighten the load.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the chief of the sailors” is rendered “the captain,” and “the god” (that is, Jonah’s god) “your God.”
Close to the Hebrew; “this evil” is rendered “this trouble.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the sea was going and storming” is rendered “the sea was growing more tempestuous.”
Close to the Hebrew; “by the life of this man” is rendered “for this man’s life,” and “do not put on us innocent blood” “do not charge us with innocent blood.”
MT 2:1. Close to the Hebrew; “Yahweh appointed” is rendered “the LORD had prepared,” and “the inward parts” “the belly.”
